question: At which of the following places did the Indian Iron and Steel Company set up its first factory?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hirapur.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Iron and Steel Company:- **

 
 
• **The Indian Iron and Steel Company (IISCO) set up its first factory in Hirapur, West Bengal. **
 
• The factory was established in 1918 and was later renamed Burnpur.
 
• **It is now a subsidiary of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL).**
 
• **It has a crude steel production capacity of 2.5 million tonnes per year. **
 
• It produces a wide range of steel products, including pig iron, billets, blooms, slabs, and rolled sections.
